source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
During your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), you may pick as many as 3 **ADEPTA SORORITAS** units of yours, including any embarked within **TRANSPORTS**. Until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) starts, they are Righteous, which gives:

- Their models add 1" to their Move.
- Their models improve their Leadership by 1.
- Weapons on their **PARAGON WARSUITS**, **CELESTIAN SACRESANTS**, **CELESTIAN INSIDIANTS** and **BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD** models improve their Ballistic Skill and Weapon Skill by 1.
